channel.title: Paksh: International
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Trump Discusses Denuclearization with Russia and China
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated that he is engaged in discussions with Russia and China concerning denuclearization. These talks involve Washington, Beijing, and Moscow. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Sanctions Networks Linked to Iran
item.description: The United States has imposed sanctions on networks based in Hong Kong and Dubai, described as being linked to Iran. Additionally, Cuban and Iraqi banks have been sanctioned by the US due to their ties to Iran. These actions represent a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Destroys Iran-Affiliated Boat in Gulf of Oman
item.description: The U.S. military destroyed an Iran-affiliated boat in the Gulf of Oman, stating it conducted surveillance and targeted the navy. The U.S. military evacuated the crew before destroying the vessel. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Iran Increases Attacks on Shipping Amid US War Threat
item.description: Iran is reportedly shifting tactics to increase attacks on shipping, with officials suggesting this is happening before the US vote. This comes as Iran fights a spike in militant attacks domestically, occurring as a US war threat looms… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 14 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump claims Iran war could end soon
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that a war with Iran would end "very soon" and "soon as I want it to end." The statements were made without providing further details on the context or specific plans. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ukraine War's Impact Reaches Bulgarian Fishing Village
item.description: The conflict in Ukraine has extended its reach to a Bulgarian fishing village, with debris from the war washing ashore. The war's progression and its potential impact on the upcoming winter season are being closely watched. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US and China Vie for AI Leadership Ahead of Shenzhen Summit
item.description: The United States and China are competing to set the global agenda for artificial intelligence (AI) in anticipation of talks between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen. Sources indicate this competition… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump doubts China and Russia aid to Iran
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump stated he does not believe China and Russia are providing any assistance to Iran. This statement was reported by multiple news outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China's Mongla Port Loan Sparks India-Bangladesh Rivalry Concerns
item.description: China has provided a $336 million loan for the development of Mongla Port in Bangladesh, a move that is reportedly fueling rivalry between India and Bangladesh. The coverage highlights the significance of this deal within the context of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Navy hands over command of CMF training task force in Bahrain
item.description: The Indian Navy has relinquished command of the Combined Maritime Forces (CMF) training task force, CTF 154, in Bahrain. India had held command of the 47-nation maritime partnership's task force since February 11, 2026. A ceremony was held… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Ethiopian Forces Enter Tigray Town of Adwa
item.description: Ethiopian government forces have entered the key Tigray town of Adwa, located near the Eritrean border, following the withdrawal of rebel forces. Witnesses reported the advance, with Ethiopian forces tightening their grip on the region. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Middle East Tensions Escalate with Focus on Israel and Iran
item.description: Tensions in the Middle East are ongoing, with significant focus on developments involving Israel and Iran. Coverage includes live updates on the situation in Israel, Iran, and the broader Middle East region, as well as news concerning the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Ukraine Halts Drone Strikes on Russian Oil Refineries
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine has halted drone strikes on Russian oil refineries for two days. The reasons for this pause were not specified in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz, Yemen airstrikes reported
item.description: A vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz area. Separately, airstrikes were conducted on Yemen's capital. These events are part of broader Middle East developments. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: France Open to Defense Deals With Canada
item.description: France remains open to defense deals with Canada, even as Canada pursues greater autonomy in its arms industry, according to a French envoy. This openness suggests continued collaboration possibilities between the two nations in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EU sanctions nearly 1,600 Russian individuals and firms over weapons production
item.description: The European Union adopted nearly 1,600 new sanctions listings that target Russian individuals and firms linked to the production of arms, drones and missiles. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 3.

item.title: Gaza Ceasefire Stalled a Year After US-Brokered Deal, NGOs Say
item.description: A year after a US-brokered ceasefire was intended to end the war in Gaza, progress has stalled, with more than 100 NGOs stating the ceasefire "exists in name only." While a ceasefire was promised, Palestinians report that the past 12… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran Claims US Response to Hormuz Proposal Insufficient
item.description: Iran has stated that the United States' response to its proposal for reopening the Strait of Hormuz was insufficient. According to Iranian claims, the US accepted some of Iran's seven conditions. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 11 · Right 2.

item.title: Taiwan Monitors Chinese Live-Fire Drills Near Coast
item.description: Taiwan is closely monitoring a series of Chinese live-fire drills scheduled to last all week, with the closest drill taking place off China's eastern province of Zhejiang. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump claims Ukraine-Russia 'energy ceasefire'; Kyiv reports strikes
item.description: Former US President Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire" between Russia and Ukraine, stating that both sides had agreed to it. However, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that Russia had carried out fresh strikes on… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 16 · Right 3.

item.title: Iran-US Talks Stall Over Strait of Hormuz Deal
item.description: Iran has stated that the United States has accepted some of its demands concerning the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, but negotiations are stalled. An Iranian official indicated that the US needs to clarify remaining issues that are… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
